community.name: Ulukhaktok
community.institution: This dashboard is provided by the Alfred Wegener Institute Helmholtz Centre for Polar and Marine Research.

marine.title: Forecast for Today Tonight and Saturday.
marine.text:
Wind west 25 knots diminishing to west 15 this afternoon and to
light this evening. Wind increasing to southeast 20 near noon
Saturday. Snow changing to scattered flurries near noon. Blowing snow
early this afternoon. Visibility 1 mile or less in snow and as low as 1 mile in
blowing snow. Temperatures near minus 2. <br/>

marine.title: Waves for Today Tonight and Saturday.
marine.text:
Outside the ice edge seas 1 metre or less building to 1 to 2 late
this morning then subsiding to 1 or less this evening.<br/>

marine.title: Extended Forecast
marine.text:
Sunday: Wind southeast 20 knots veering to southwest 15
 in the morning then increasing to west 25 in the afternoon.<br/>Monday: Wind southwest 20 knots veering to northwest 15
 late in the day.<br/>Tuesday: Wind light.<br/>
